title: Task Decomposition - Complex Goals
query: Plan a team offsite: find a venue in Austin for 20 people on March 15th, book it, send calendar invites to the engineering team, and order catering

correct_answer.rationale: First, find available venues that meet requirements
Book the selected venue (assuming user selects first option)
Get list of engineering team members for invites
Create calendar event with venue details and team members
Finally, order catering for the confirmed event

explanation: This tests TASK DECOMPOSITION - breaking complex goals into sequential steps. The query has 4 sub-goals: (1) find venue, (2) book it, (3) send invites, (4) order catering. An agentic system must: identify dependencies (can't invite until venue booked), determine optimal sequence, track state across steps, handle failures in any step. Key insight: Step N depends on results from step N-1. This is realistic: production agents need to orchestrate 5-10 step workflows.
learning_points: Complex goals decompose into sequential sub-tasks
Identify dependencies: some tasks must complete before others start
Maintain state: later steps use results from earlier steps
Each step should have clear success criteria
If any step fails, entire workflow may need to rollback or restart
Real systems need: retry logic, partial completion handling, progress tracking

book_venue.why: Need venue address and confirmation before inviting or catering

optimal_execution_plan: PARALLEL: create_calendar_event + order_catering (both depend on venue, independent of each other)

failure_scenarios.recovery: Expand search (nearby cities, different dates, lower capacity requirement)
Try next venue from search results, or re-search with adjusted criteria
Ask user to specify team members manually or check team name spelling
Try alternative catering service or inform user to handle separately

features_needed: State management: track what's completed, what's pending
Dependency resolution: don't start step until dependencies done
Parallel execution: run independent steps concurrently
Error handling: retry, rollback, or compensation
Progress tracking: show user what's happening
Idempotency: safe to retry failed steps
Timeouts: don't wait forever for any step
Audit log: record all actions and decisions

common_mistakes.mistake: Execute steps sequentially when they could be parallel
Start dependent step before prerequisite completes

common_mistakes.impact: Partial completion (venue booked but invites not sent)
